target.title: feat(github-copilot): support GitHub Enterprise data-residency Copilot auth
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Organizations on a data-residency GitHub Enterprise tenant (a `*.ghe.com` host such as `your-org.ghe.com`) could not use GitHub Copilot with OpenClaw. Copilot auth, token refresh, and completions were hardwired to public `github.com` / `api.github.com`, so onboarding via `openclaw models auth` and the Copilot provider offered no way to reach a tenant-local Copilot endpoint. Enterprise users were effectively locked out of the Copilot provider.

## Why This Change Was Made

Adds GitHub Enterprise (data residency) as a first-class Copilot auth choice, nested alongside the existing GitHub and Local Proxy options. Picking it prompts for the tenant domain, runs the device login against that host, and persists the domain to `models.providers.github-copilot.params.githubDomain` so later token refreshes and completions resolve automatically. Domain resolution follows `COPILOT_GITHUB_DOMAIN` env > config > `github.com`, with a normalization guard (`^[a-z0-9.-]+$`) that rejects scheme/path/credential injection and the existing SSRF allowlist keyed off the normalized domain. The domain is threaded through every Copilot code path — device flow, token exchange, completions, embeddings, image understanding, and simple-completion — so all features work on the tenant, not just chat. Public `github.com` behavior is unchanged (no config is written for the default host). No config schema change (uses free-form provider params).

## User Impact

Enterprise users can now authenticate Copilot against their `*.ghe.com` tenant directly from onboarding or `openclaw models auth` by choosing **GitHub Copilot (Enterprise / data residency)** and entering their domain — no manual URL editing. Chat, embeddings (memory search), and image understanding all route to the tenant. `COPILOT_GITHUB_DOMAIN` enables fully headless/CI setups. Non-enterprise users see no change.

## Evidence

- Validated end-to-end in Docker against a real `*.ghe.com` tenant: chat confirmed working; embeddings verifiable via `openclaw memory status --deep` and image understanding via `openclaw infer image.describe --model github-copilot/<model>`, both routing to the tenant.
- Targeted tests updated and passing: `provider-auth.test.ts`, provider-auth contract, `registry.contract.test.ts`, `index.test.ts`, `login.test.ts`, `simple-completion-runtime.test.ts`.
- Typecheck (tsgo core + extensions), lint (`lint:extensions`), and format (oxfmt) all clean.
- Docs added: "GitHub Enterprise (data residency)" section in `docs/providers/github-copilot.md`.
